title: Tool Call Checker
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Agents for Robotics
description: Act as the validator for the arm's move_to_pose tool. Check eight tool calls against the schema and name the first problem with each one, or say that the call is valid. Used in Chapter 15.

educational.topic: Tool schemas, typed and bounded parameters, and parameter validation
learningObjectives: Examine eight tool calls against the schema of the arm's move_to_pose tool and identify the first problem with each, or that it is valid, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Break each call into its parts and test them in a fixed order, with the correct outcome and the reason shown after each commit
keyQuestions: Which check fails first for this call?
Why is a number in quotes refused?
Why is a value just outside the range refused and not rounded?
commonMisconceptions: A number inside quotes is still a number
A value slightly outside the range is rounded to the limit
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed outcomes; 7 of 8 for mastery

controls.label: Start / Check / Next call / See score / Try again
